# Security policy

Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue. Use the
repository's private security advisory flow. If private advisories are not
enabled, the repository owner must publish a private reporting address before
the site is exposed publicly; this file deliberately does not invent one.

Include the affected version or image digest, impact, reproduction steps, and
whether credentials or personal data may be involved. Do not attach real
visitor data, contact messages, tokens, database dumps, or SMTP credentials.

The maintainer should acknowledge a complete report within five working days,
contain active exposure first, and publish remediation details only after users
have a safe upgrade path.
